name: Ruins of Tapoyauik - Amoxliatl chamber
accessNote: Repeatable Amoxliatl boss chamber after The Heart of Darkness. Use the lift from the mural/statue chamber after the quest to unlock the permanent Tower of Ascension shortcut. A charged Pendant of Ates can reach Twilight Temple after its statue is activated; quetzal routes are alternatives. This boss chamber is distinct from the nearby blue-dragon safespots.
